theme: Committing money before you know if it works
title: Capex Stage-Gate: Sizing Commitments by What They Teach You
strategies: full commitment: build every module in one giant stage, never checking in (destroys all option value but pays no repeated mobilization overhead)

equal-cost tranches: split the fixed build order into a fixed number of roughly equal-dollar stages and vote on signals seen so far -- naive staging that ignores WHICH modules are actually informative

information-per-dollar staging: isolate any module whose signal accuracy is far from a coin flip into its own thin, cheap probing stage, batch the rest, and choose continue/abandon by exact backward-induction on the true Bayesian posterior at every reachable signal history

exhaustive partition search (unused headroom): brute-force every possible stage boundary set (all 2^(M-1) partitions) with optimal decisions at each, which the reference strong solution deliberately does NOT do
